q_A: SELECT museum_id , name FROM museum ORDER BY num_of_staff DESC LIMIT 1
gold_q_B: SELECT "museum"."mus_id" AS "museum_id", "museum"."Name" AS "name" FROM "museum" AS "museum" ORDER BY "museum"."num_stf" DESC LIMIT 1

q_A: SELECT avg(num_of_staff) FROM museum WHERE open_year < 2009
gold_q_B: SELECT AVG("museum"."num_stf") AS "_col_0" FROM "museum" AS "museum" WHERE "museum"."Open_Year" < 2009

q_A: SELECT Num_of_Staff , Open_Year FROM museum WHERE name = 'Plaza Museum'
gold_q_B: SELECT "museum"."num_stf" AS "num_of_staff", "museum"."Open_Year" AS "open_year" FROM "museum" AS "museum" WHERE "museum"."Name" = 'Plaza Museum'

q_A: SELECT name FROM museum WHERE num_of_staff > (SELECT min(num_of_staff) FROM museum WHERE open_year > 2010)
gold_q_B: SELECT "museum"."Name" AS "name" FROM "museum" AS "museum" WHERE "museum"."num_stf" > (SELECT MIN("museum"."num_stf") AS "_col_0" FROM "museum" AS "museum" WHERE "museum"."Open_Year" > 2010)

q_A: SELECT t2.Museum_ID , t1.name FROM museum AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.Museum_ID = t2.Museum_ID GROUP BY t2.Museum_ID ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
gold_q_B: SELECT "t2"."Museum_ID" AS "museum_id", "t1"."Name" AS "name" FROM "museum" AS "t1" JOIN "visit" AS "t2" ON "t1"."mus_id" = "t2"."Museum_ID" GROUP BY "t2"."Museum_ID" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q_A: SELECT name FROM museum WHERE Museum_ID NOT IN (SELECT museum_id FROM visit)
gold_q_B: SELECT "museum"."Name" AS "name" FROM "museum" AS "museum" WHERE NOT "museum"."mus_id" IN (SELECT "visit"."Museum_ID" AS "museum_id" FROM "visit" AS "visit")

q_A: SELECT t1.name FROM visitor AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.visitor_id JOIN museum AS t3 ON t3.Museum_ID = t2.Museum_ID WHERE t3.open_year < 2009 INTERSECT SELECT t1.name FROM visitor AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.visitor_id JOIN museum AS t3 ON t3.Museum_ID = t2.Museum_ID WHERE t3.open_year > 2011
gold_q_B: SELECT "t1"."Name" AS "name" FROM "visitor" AS "t1" JOIN "visit" AS "t2" ON "t1"."ID" = "t2"."visitor_ID" JOIN "museum" AS "t3" ON "t3"."mus_id" = "t2"."Museum_ID" WHERE "t3"."Open_Year" < 2009 INTERSECT SELECT "t1"."Name" AS "name" FROM "visitor" AS "t1" JOIN "visit" AS "t2" ON "t1"."ID" = "t2"."visitor_ID" JOIN "museum" AS "t3" ON "t3"."mus_id" = "t2"."Museum_ID" WHERE "t3"."Open_Year" > 2011

q_A: SELECT count(*) FROM visitor WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT t2.visitor_id FROM museum AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.Museum_ID = t2.Museum_ID WHERE t1.open_year > 2010)
gold_q_B: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "_col_0" FROM "visitor" AS "visitor" WHERE NOT "visitor"."ID" IN (SELECT "t2"."visitor_ID" AS "visitor_id" FROM "museum" AS "t1" JOIN "visit" AS "t2" ON "t1"."mus_id" = "t2"."Museum_ID" WHERE "t1"."Open_Year" > 2010)
